title: Cumulative distribution function vanishes at zero
statement: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\mathrm{Fin}\,m$. Then the cumulative probability $\sum_{j < 0} p(j)$ vanishes; that is, $\mathrm{cdf}(p, 0) = 0$ in $\bbr_{\ge 0}^\infty$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\mathrm{Fin}\,m$
